notes.title: Patch fix
notes.content:
Cursor wasn't fixed in the last update and has now been fixed to point upwards.

Level 20 had an issue with one rock being non-selectable due a weird bug with its placement so was moved over one unit to the right.

notes.title: Bug fix on level 20; cursor update
notes.content:
Cursor updated to be facing down now.

Level 20 issue (which was broken in one of the latest patches) where enemies were spawning without bars and unkillable, has now been fixed.

notes.title: 6/21/2023 Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed an Issue where Level 3 Slicers were not display damage correctly, despite doing the correct damage.
Fixed a rare bug where some of the rocks would not display their correct hitpoints.
Undid a new bug where the "Press anyone button to continue" did not show up on boss levels.

notes.title: 5/27/2024 - Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed an issue where summoned tanks and tripods were giving too much serum reward after being brought in by summoners.

notes.title: 5/23/2023 Bug fixes and performance
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where there was an extra destructible in the wrong place on lvl 49.
 General streamlining
 Fixed an issue where special percentages would show up before the level started.

notes.title: 5/9/2023 Performance and Bug Patch
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where Level 3 red Toasters were not indicating that they were critical hitting mechanical enemies.
Fixed an issue on level 12 where there was an extra rock in an incorrect position. 
Fixed an issue on level 12 where level environment was not using correct image.
 Shrunk game size and (hopefully) improved performance and launch speed.

notes.title: 5/7 Small Patch
notes.content: Fixed issue where Slicer were not displaying indicator to show that they were missing flying targets.

notes.title: Bug fixes, 5/5/2023
notes.content:
Reduced the lvl 3 Blazer's long range attack by about 15% to more accurately reflect its range.
 Fixed a bug where Level 3 Longfancies couldnt be deselected.
 Fixed an issue where placing a Trinity would rarely leave a green square behind.
 Fixed an issue Trinities were sometimes bugging out when multiple ones are on the map at the same time.
 Fixed an issue with Lvl 4 Boomers when a huge amount of them are in play at once. 
 Fixed an issue where attacking Lvl 4 Boomer bombs were causing projectiles to disappear.
 General performance optimization.

notes.title: 4/15: Performance optimization on map; reduce UI clutter slightly
notes.content:
Tried to address some performance issues on the map.

Reduced size of Slicer pack bonus display to be less obtrusive of things and enemies behind it.

Fixed issue where "!" would display over the score on level 17.

notes.title: 4/14: Minor Bug fixes and UI changes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where rarely a green placement square would remain even after a Slicer was placed.

Fixed an issue where Headbutts could be placed on top of other towers with a little bit of finesse, or totally unintentionally.

Improved level complete so that the special ability bar no longer shows when a level is finished.

notes.title: Bug Fix on Final Boss, Difficulty Select and Main Menu
notes.content:
Bug fixes for March 9th:


 Final boss (level 50) was sometimes freezing when the player loses due to her attacks.
 Clicking "hard" difficulty from a new game didn't properly display the selection of the hard mode icon of level 1
 Main menu "New game" is fixed so that the difficulty select won't immediately disappear when the player is not selecting the button, removing a minor nuisance

notes.title: Bug fixes and animation improvements
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where level 1 slicers were always displaying that they were critically hitting, despite not
 Fixed an issue where Blazers wouldn't indicate when they were critically hitting
 Small performance streamlining
 Improved animations of idle towers

notes.title: Small but big bug patch (Infinite serum glitch)
notes.content:
A friendly user noted a big bug that I was an idiot to not have noticed. 

The Stiletto dinos could be used to generate infinite money, reaching into the tens of thousands. Oops.


It has promptly been patched.

Even more foolish is that I specifically stated in the game tips there was no endless money glitch.

Other patches on the way, hopefully: performance, fixing the game taskbar icon, and hunting down possible memory leaks.
